selection_rule: Compare study winner and baseline using TrackEval COMBINED_SEQ on all five development windows (1625 frames). Highest HOTA, then IDF1, then FPS. Freeze the winner before accessing held-out results.
held_out_protocol: After freezing, run baseline and selected configuration on every frame of MOT17-11-FRCNN and MOT17-13-FRCNN. Report both outcomes without further tuning.
